workflow.title: On-call digest for #it-oncall
workflow.goal: Each run, post one digest of the unresolved alerts of the last 168 hours (warning and above) to #it-oncall after a person approves the post.

assumptions: The alerts sheet holds one row per alert with id, at, service, severity, message, acknowledged and resolved
The channel is a local file standing in for chat and the outbox stands in for e-mail; nothing leaves this machine
risks: Paging the wrong person or paging for nothing
successCriteria: One digest was posted to the channel you named
This run left exactly the planned post and e-mails, each intact (checked by re-reading them)
unsupported: Running on a schedule by itself

nodes.description: Work out how many hours ago each alert was raised
Keep unresolved alerts in the window at the chosen severity or above
